reels.title: M02 BUZ KUBU
reels.caption:
Nothing is changing? Maybe you're at 31°. 🧊

Weeks of work and the ice doesn't move. Most people quit right here. But the work isn't lost. It's stored. At 32°, everything changes at once.

Send this to someone stuck at 31°.

#consistency #discipline #selfimprovement #motivation #habits

reels.title: M06 1%
reels.caption:
1% better or 1% worse. Every single day. 📈

1.01^365 = 37.8
0.99^365 = 0.03
Same start. Different choices.

Send this to your 1% friend.

#1percentbetter #selfimprovement #discipline #habits #motivation

reels.title: M13 KOPRU
reels.caption:
You don't lose friends in a fight. You lose them to "next week." 🌉

One more deadline. One more late night. One more "sorry, I'm busy." Work will always want more hours. A friend only needs one.

Send this to the friend you keep telling "next week."

#friendship #worklifebalance #truefriends #lifelessons #selfgrowth

reels.title: M14 FENER
reels.caption:
Stop waiting for the perfect plan. Start with a bad one. 🔦

Day 1, same dream. One starts with a bad plan. One waits for a perfect one. A year later, one has a road behind him. The other has 41 plans on paper.

You don't need to see the whole road. Just the next step.

Send this to someone still waiting for the perfect plan.

#perfectionism #juststart #discipline #selfimprovement #motivation

reels.title: M15 QUM SAATI
reels.caption:
Every swipe feels free. It's paid in time. ⏳

The average person spends ~4 hours a day on their phone. From 18 to 74, that's about 9 years of your life, gone one swipe at a time.

Put it down before it runs out.

Send this to someone who needs to put the phone down.

#screentime #phoneaddiction #timemanagement #selfimprovement #digitaldetox
